[documentation-forward] api-client.js line 105 getKnowledge JSDoc prose says 'Falsy or empty param values are silently omitted from the query string by buildQueryString' — but buildQueryString only omits values that are === undefined or === ''. Truthy-false values like null, 0, and false are NOT omitted (they would be serialised into the query string). Update the prose to read 'undefined or empty-string values are silently omitted' to match the actual code behaviour in buildQueryString.
